tests.title: A member-only promo code is refused for guests and for members below the allowed level
tests.goal: Level-restricted codes reach only the intended members.
preconditions: A QA code promotion with "Member only" and only a level the QA member does not have (e.g. Level 5) ticked, created in the CRM during the test

steps.text: As a guest apply the code at /checkout
As the QA member (lower level) apply it
Tick the member's level in the promotion and apply again as the member

expected.text: Step 3: applied with the promotion discount

$12026-10-28 partial run (not recorded: guest step not run because logging out would lose the QA member session): Level-5-only code QALVL1028 (promotion 663, deleted after) refused for the Level 1 member with "Current shopping cart does not meet the promotion code conditions"; after ticking Level 1 it applied (-HKD 15). The refusal message does not say the code is for other member levels.
